name: EU AI Act — Risk Classification
description: Determine an AI system's risk tier under the EU AI Act (prohibited / high / limited / minimal). Informational, not legal advice.

rules.title: Subliminal/manipulative techniques
rules.description: Prohibited: AI deploying subliminal or purposefully manipulative/deceptive techniques that materially distort behavior and cause harm.

check.question: Does the system deploy subliminal or purposefully manipulative/deceptive techniques that materially distort behavior and cause harm?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5.

rules.title: Exploitation of vulnerabilities
rules.description: Prohibited: exploiting vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or social/economic situation to distort behavior and cause harm.

check.question: Does the system exploit vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or social/economic situation to distort behavior and cause harm?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5.

rules.title: Social scoring
rules.description: Prohibited: evaluating or classifying persons via social behavior leading to detrimental or unjustified treatment.

check.question: Does the system evaluate or classify persons via social behavior leading to detrimental/unjustified treatment?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5.

rules.title: Predictive policing by profiling
rules.description: Prohibited: assessing the risk of a person committing a crime based solely on profiling or personality traits.

check.question: Does the system assess the risk of a person committing a crime based solely on profiling or personality traits?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5.

rules.title: Untargeted facial-image scraping
rules.description: Prohibited: creating or expanding facial-recognition databases via untargeted scraping of facial images.

check.question: Does the system create/expand facial-recognition databases via untargeted scraping of facial images?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5.

rules.title: Emotion inference at work/school
rules.description: Prohibited: inferring emotions in the workplace or education settings (outside medical/safety purposes).

check.question: Does the system infer emotions in the workplace or education settings (outside medical/safety)?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5.

rules.title: Sensitive biometric categorization
rules.description: Prohibited: categorizing persons by biometric data to infer race, political opinions, religion, sexual orientation, or other sensitive attributes.

check.question: Does the system categorize persons by biometric data to infer race, political opinions, religion, sexual orientation, etc.?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5.

rules.title: Real-time remote biometric ID
rules.description: Prohibited (outside narrow exceptions): real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement.

check.question: Does the system perform real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement (outside narrow exceptions)?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Do not place on the market or put into service — this practice is prohibited under Article 5 (subject to narrow, authorised exceptions).

rules.title: Safety component of regulated product
rules.description: High-risk: AI used as a safety component of a product covered by Annex I Union harmonization law requiring third-party conformity assessment.

check.question: Is the AI a safety component of a product covered by Annex I Union harmonization law requiring third-party conformity assessment?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Biometrics
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §1): biometric identification, categorization, or emotion recognition (non-prohibited uses).

check.question: Is the system used for biometric identification, categorization, or emotion recognition (non-prohibited)?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Critical infrastructure
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §2): safety component in the management/operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, or utilities.

check.question: Is the system a safety component in the management/operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, or utilities?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Education & vocational training
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §3): admissions, evaluation of learning outcomes, or proctoring in education.

check.question: Is the system used for admissions, evaluation of learning outcomes, or proctoring in education?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Employment & worker management
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §4): recruitment, selection, promotion/termination, or task allocation/monitoring of workers.

check.question: Is the system used for recruitment, selection, promotion/termination, or task allocation/monitoring of workers?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Access to essential services
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §5): evaluating eligibility for essential public benefits, creditworthiness, or insurance/emergency dispatch.

check.question: Is the system used to evaluate eligibility for essential public benefits, creditworthiness, or insurance/emergency dispatch?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Law enforcement
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §6): law-enforcement use for risk assessment, evidence evaluation, or profiling.

check.question: Is the system used by law enforcement for risk assessment, evidence evaluation, or profiling?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Migration, asylum & border control
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §7): migration/asylum/border management (risk assessment, application examination).

check.question: Is the system used for migration/asylum/border management (risk assessment, application examination)?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Justice & democratic processes
rules.description: High-risk (Annex III §8): assisting judicial authorities or influencing elections/referenda.

check.question: Is the system used to assist judicial authorities or to influence elections/referenda?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Treat as high-risk: comply with Chapter III (see the high-risk-requirements pack).

rules.title: Limited-risk transparency trigger
rules.description: Limited-risk: systems that interact with people, generate synthetic content, or perform emotion/biometric categorization trigger Article 50 transparency duties.

check.question: Does the system interact with people, generate synthetic content, or perform emotion/biometric categorization?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: Apply the Article 50 transparency obligations (see the transparency pack).

rules.title: Minimal-risk (voluntary)
rules.description: Minimal-risk: systems not captured by the prohibited, high-risk, or transparency categories carry no mandatory obligations.

check.question: If none of the prohibited/high-risk/transparency rules apply, is the system minimal-risk?
check.evidence_prompt: Describe the system's purpose and link supporting analysis.

rules.remediation: No mandatory obligations; consider adhering to voluntary codes of conduct under Article 95.
